input_transform: [log1p(dt),log1p(q)] with mask; no train-zscore in common continuous_features
quantity_output: expm1(softplus(a)); mathematically exp(a), subject to floating point/softplus threshold implementation
train_log_mean_use: quantity_head initial bias only for this active quantity route
train_log_std_use: validated constructor argument; quantity scale initialization only for inactive optional lognormal variant
joint_objective: recorded positive-integer duration NLL + 1.0*log quantity MSE
checkpoint_selector: first strict finite minimum full Validation raw quantity RMSE; this is selection, not raw-MSE training

mathematical_estimands.median_caveat: The log-MSE inverse mean is not generally the raw conditional median; symmetry of log(1+Q)|X is a sufficient extra condition. No Gaussian assumption or variance correction is implemented here.
mathematical_estimands.finite_model_caveat: Joint training, finite capacity, regularization, optimization, early stopping and selected checkpoint need not attain population optimum.

derivatives.same_relative_error: For p=(1+r)q and q large, L tends to log(1+r)^2; r>-1

cap_task.transform: Qc=min(Q,C), C=pooled original Train-event Q75 per dataset
cap_task.cap_mass: P(Qc=C|X)=P(Q>=C|X); includes naturally equal-C events and capped higher events
cap_task.strict_tail: Qc>C empty by construction; N/A not zero error
cap_task.not_identifiable: Raw values above C and differences in capped histories cannot be recovered from capped quantity alone; no inference of impossible prediction under uncapped history.

diagnostic_priority: Compare stored Train/Validation signed error, AE, SSE, log error by fixed Train quantity bins with support, entity composition and seeds; truth-bin underprediction alone is not conditional calibration evidence.
Calibration by prediction/history-only groups fixed from Train; show raw and log mean residual, cap-hit vs below-cap, stable vs abrupt change with sample counts.
Separate high-tail underprediction from rare overprediction and error concentration; compare across arms with identical target rows.
Use stored epoch curves to distinguish persistent Train+Val misfit from Val-only gap; do not add inference or change checkpoint.
decision: Do not attribute all errors to log1p or model complexity. Finish existing Cap27 unchanged; code confirms objective/metric estimand mismatch but row evidence is required before proposing any new objective/head experiment.

external_sources.support: transformed forecast back-transformation and bias-adjustment caveat; formulas above are separately derived for log1p

older_raw_experiment_reference.registered_scope: Intermittent seed42 50epochs marked TitanTPP small_lmm direct_raw_qty; global/causalRevIN/shrinkageRevIN
